title: New care with honest terms

captions.physics: Taking responsibility for a definite offer
captions.energy: Trying an unfamiliar way to participate
captions.emotions: Feeling fairness in a free response

meaning: An unfamiliar form of care can feel honest and warm when responsibility for an offer does not determine someone else’s agreement.
text: A new form of tenderness can begin without a tested script. In the physical position of Anahata, the Emperor expresses care through concrete responsibility: agreeing arrangements, preparing what is needed and keeping a promise. The Fool in energy brings a wish to try unfamiliar involvement without knowing beforehand how it will be received. Justice in emotions offers satisfaction in honest terms. Responding becomes easier when freedom to agree is clear and nobody owes a reward for another person’s initiative. Novelty can stay warm when responsibility remains understandable beside it.

You decide sometimes to take turns inventing a small outing. Today one person frees time and suggests a new route through a familiar neighbourhood, while the other can clarify its length or choose another place. **Responsibility for an offer does not include a right to agreement.** Preparation already expresses care, but the meeting is still created by two people. Even an unsuccessful first idea need not become a debt: changing it together preserves pleasure in the wish to delight each other.

The difficulty is treating turns as a duty to accept every proposal. Once someone has prepared, the other supposedly cannot alter anything. Novelty gains a rigid rule, and fairness becomes compulsory exchange. Care stays honest when declining or clarifying is equally possible for both, without cancelling acknowledgement of the effort made by whoever planned the meeting.
